description: Fallback classifier for documents that do not match the supported partnership Schedule K-1 blueprint. Every result requires human review.

document_classification.instruction: Classify as POSSIBLE_SCHEDULE_K1_FORM_1065, OTHER_SCHEDULE_K1, OTHER_TAX_FORM, UNRELATED, or UNKNOWN.

detected_form_label.instruction: Visible form title or number, or blank when absent.

reason.instruction: Short non-sensitive explanation for routing this document to review.
